notes: The [-8]: 'Discard your hand, then draw seven cards. Until end of turn, you may cast spells from your hand without paying their mana costs.' Seeded at 8 loyalty, Chandra goes to the graveyard as the cost is paid (CR 704.5i) and the ability resolves anyway (CR 113.7a): seven cards drawn, Crash Through on top among them. Its permission is an effect of the resolved ability (CR 611.2a), so it outlives her: with no mana in the pool the menu offers Crash Through through it (cast:ct:via:cf, a free cast, CR 118.9) and it resolves (draw a card: hand 7). Before ontology round R13 the permission was suppressed (B-49 follow-up #1: its free activation cast for nothing on any turn) and the card was engine-unsupported.
